description:
Get a filtered option chain suitable for spread evaluation.

Returns a markdown table of surviving contracts with one row per leg.
Header line carries the underlying price and the active filter constants.

days_to_expiration.description: Maximum days to expiration to include (default 21).

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

strike_count.description:
Approximate total strikes returned, centered on ATM
(default 20).

symbol.description:
Underlying ticker (equity or ETF). For index options use the
$-prefix form: $SPX, $NDX, $RUT.

name: schwab_get_option_chain
